{"layout":"square","prompt":"Edit the provided product photo (use the attached image) into a square (1:1) catalog shot. Requirements:
- Remove window glare/reflection on the bottle surface while preserving the bottle texture and finish; eliminate the bright window highlight so the bottle looks evenly lit but keep natural specular highlights subtle.
- Preserve the printed label exactly: do not change any wording, typography, spacing, or colors on the label. The label text must remain word-for-word identical and fully legible.
- Replace the background with a warm gray studio background (warm neutral gray, subtly warm tone). Smooth, even backdrop with no patterns or gradients that distract; include a subtle soft shadow directly beneath the bottle to ground it.
- Crop/compose for a centered square catalog shot: bottle centered, full bottle visible (do not crop or cut off the label), with typical catalog padding around the product.
- Maintain original bottle and label colors and overall photorealistic look; no additional graphics, logos, or text.
- Output as a high-resolution, photorealistic edited image suitable for a product catalog.

Do not add or alter any label text or add any new text. Keep edits limited to glare removal, background replacement, centering/cropping, and subtle lighting adjustments to look like a studio catalog photo."}
tool_calls.name: image_generate
